commands.stdout:
Remove one installed version; use --all for multiple matching versions

Usage: aster tool uninstall [OPTIONS] <TOOL>

Arguments:
  <TOOL>  

Options:
      --all                   Remove every installed version matching the named tool and optional prefix
      --dry-run               Show the selected versions without removing files or editing declarations
      --dry-run-code          Preview removal and exit with status 1 when matching versions exist
      --unpin                 Also drop the project pin; an exact version only drops the same literal pin
      --json                  
      --debug                 Enable debug logging
      --debug-file <FILE>     Write debug logs to FILE
  -h, --help                  Print help
      --leader-socket <PATH>  Use a custom leader socket path instead of the default `~/.aster/leader.sock`. A local/branch build can thus run an isolated leader without colliding with the default one already running on the machine Name it `~/.aster/leader-*.sock` to keep `aster leader list/kill` able to find it; any other location works but won't be auto-discovered
